note: Bavli: [Avodah Zarah 37a:3](sefaria:Avodah_Zarah.37a.3) (3 segments). Gazetteer: “Yosef the Permissive”. Talmud explains the epithet: Yosei ben Yoezer permitted three things, 'and they called him Yosef Sharya'; 37b:5 objects 'he should be called Yosef Asra'. Gazetteer also has 'Yosef the Prohibiting' (יוסף אסרא, same passage).

Bavli: [Kiddushin 53a:9](sefaria:Kiddushin.53a.9) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “ben Ḥamtzan”. Talmud explains the name: a man snatched his and his fellow's share 'and they called him ben Ḥamtzan until the day he died'. Also fits 'Patronymic, Not Father's Name' and 'Slurs'.

Bavli: [Sanhedrin 67a:15](sefaria:Sanhedrin.67a.15) (3 segments). Gazetteer: “ben Stada”. Talmud explains the double name: 'his mother was Stada... as they say in Pumbedita, she strayed (סטת דא) from her husband'. Also fits Matronymic and Slurs. Not in paper in any spelling.
